methodology_note: Following Gilardi et al. 2023 (PNAS) and Pangakis et al. 2023, we use LLMs as additional independent annotators alongside the human expert. This produces tractable inter-rater statistics in the absence of multiple human annotators. Pairwise Cohen κ between expert and LLM raters quantifies whether expert annotation falls within the inter-rater agreement envelope a naive LLM annotator would produce.
correction_note: Previously reported as 0.4509. The repository's hand-rolled krippendorff_alpha double-counted diagonal coincidences (each rating was credited with a coincidence against itself), inflating observed agreement. The corrected implementation matches the reference `krippendorff` package to four decimals: 0.2847. The three Cohen's kappas in this file were computed with scikit-learn and are unaffected.
